entities.name: Restoration of the High King
entities.description: Event on Eldraine in 4560 AR in which Algenus Kenrith was returned to the throne and the twins' spark ignited.

entities.name: Eldraine
entities.description: The plane where the restoration took place.

entities.name: Algenus Kenrith
entities.description: High King of Eldraine, abducted and cursed into a stag by Oko, later restored.

entities.name: Oko
entities.description: Planeswalker who transformed Algenus into a stag and manipulated Eldraine; exiled by planeswalking away.

entities.name: Rowan Kenrith
entities.description: Royal twin whose planeswalker spark ignites.

entities.name: Will Kenrith
entities.description: Royal twin who saves Garruk and whose planeswalker spark ignites.

entities.name: Linden Kenrith
entities.description: Queen who struggled to maintain unity among the five courts and helps revive Algenus.

entities.name: Indrelon
entities.description: The Magic Mirror whose visions guided the twins.

entities.name: Garruk
entities.description: Huntmaster enthralled by Oko and cursed by the Chain Veil, cured by the Cauldron of Eternity.

entities.name: Cauldron of Eternity
entities.description: Lost cauldron that revived Garruk and cured him of the Chain Veil's curse.

entities.name: Wild Hunt
entities.description: Ritual hunt during which the final confrontation took place.

entities.name: Ayara
entities.description: Queen whose appearance Oko took to incite war between the Realm and the Wilds.

entities.name: Questing Sword
entities.description: Sword that helped bring Algenus back to life.

events.summary: Algenus is abducted and cursed into beast form; Linden struggles to keep the five courts united.
events.quote: After Algenus was abducted and cursed into beast form, Queen Linden Kenrith struggled to maintain unity among the five courts

events.summary: On turning eighteen the twins set out to find their father, guided by Indrelon's visions.
events.quote: guided by visions from the Magic Mirror Indrelon .

events.summary: Will saves the cursed Garruk from drowning and pushes him into the Cauldron of Eternity, which cures him.
events.quote: The Cauldron revived Garruk and cured him of the Chain Veil 's curse.

events.summary: Oko, disguised as Queen Ayara, kills the enchanted stag during the Wild Hunt to incite war.
events.quote: The enchanted stag was killed by Oko, transformed to appear as Queen Ayara

events.summary: Garruk and the twins catch Oko, who planeswalks away.
events.quote: Before he could be put to trial, though, he planeswalked away.

events.summary: Algenus's human form is revealed and he is brought back to life with the Questing Sword and Linden's intervention.
events.quote: he was brought back to life.

events.summary: Shocked by the truth of their origins, the twins' sparks ignite and they planeswalk away; Oko is exiled and peace returns.
events.quote: caused the Kenrith twins' latent spark to ignite, and they planeswalked away from Eldraine.

relations.quote: after having been transformed into a stag by the planeswalker Oko
the royal twins set out to find their father

relations.note: Linden is queen; the twins are their children
relations.quote: Queen Linden Kenrith struggled to maintain unity among the five courts
